rules.statement: The parcel lies in the Johnson Creek Basin Plan District (PLDIST 'JC'), Comprehensive Plan Map designation Multi-Dwelling - Corridor (MD-C).
Maximum FAR in RM2 is 1.5 to 1 (Table 120-4).

rules.statement: RM2 has no maximum density; minimum density is 1 unit per 1,450 sq ft of site area. Land within an environmental zone may be subtracted from the minimum-density calculation (per chapter notes captured by the research pass).
rules.verbatimQuote: Table 120-4 — 'Maximum Density (See 33.120.212) ... RM2 [blank/none]'; 'Minimum Density (See 33.120.213) ... RM2 1 unit per 1,450 sq. ft. of site area'.
rules.notes: A MINIMUM-density regime — the inverse of most codes; the environmental-zone subtraction makes the site's split zoning load-bearing for density.

rules.statement: Base maximum height in RM2 is 45 ft, stepping down to 35 ft within 25 ft of a lot line abutting RF-R2.5 zones.
rules.verbatimQuote: Table 120-4 — 'Base Height (See 33.120.215) ... RM2 45 ft.'; 'Step-down Height ... Within 25 ft. of lot line abutting RF-R2.5 zones ... 35 ft.'

rules.statement: RM2 minimum setbacks: front 10 ft; side and rear 5 ft; garage entrance 5 ft/18 ft (side/rear; front).

rules.statement: Maximum building coverage in RM2 is 70% of site area on sites abutting a Civic or Neighborhood Corridor (Map 120-1), otherwise 60%. Minimum landscaped area 20%.
